steps.title: Protocol Frame Structure
steps.text: The Kafka protocol uses a binary frame with size, API key, API version, correlation ID, and client ID fields, followed by the request or response body.

steps.title: API Keys
steps.text: Over 75 API keys define operations like Produce (0), Fetch (1), ListOffsets (2), and Metadata (3). Each key identifies a specific broker operation.

steps.title: Request and Response Structure
steps.text: Requests include API key, version, and correlation ID for matching responses. VarInt encoding provides efficient integer serialization for compact wire format.

steps.title: Surgewave Native Protocol
steps.text: Surgewave also supports a high-performance native protocol with approximately 45 microsecond P50 latency, compared to roughly 15 milliseconds for the Kafka protocol.

steps.title: Hands-On Lessons
steps.text: Build a minimal custom client from scratch, debug protocol issues with hex dumps and Wireshark, and compare Surgewave native vs Kafka protocol performance.
